title: SimilarWeb Traffic Scraper Output
description: Authorized website traffic import analyses or optional official Similarweb API records. Import reports analyze user-supplied metrics, not live fetched or independently verified traffic.

results.title: SimilarWeb website traffic records
results.description: One saved result per analyzed domain, with explicit source provenance. Imported records contain observations and within-export trends; official API records retain their existing fields.

importReport.title: Import analysis JSON
importReport.description: Import-only summary, saved websites and matched comparison rows. Contains no unsaved domains.

comparisonCsv.title: Traffic comparison CSV
comparisonCsv.description: Import-only formula-safe flat observations, changes, context and included-domain shares.

importMarkdown.title: Traffic analysis report
importMarkdown.description: Import-only human-readable findings with explicit coverage and comparison limits.

agencyReport.title: Agency evidence and scope audit JSON
agencyReport.description: Import only: configurable monthly review signals, matching/other/unknown country scope and observation-level quality checks. Saved domains only; not live traffic or source certification.

alertsCsv.title: Traffic change alerts CSV
alertsCsv.description: Import only: threshold findings with exact supplied prior/current values, percentage or percentage-point units and matching adjacent-month context. No automatic notification.

qualityCsv.title: US scope and comparison-quality CSV
qualityCsv.description: Import only: missing metrics/context, period gaps, latest supplied month per scope and matched-peer coverage. Complete fields is not verified accuracy or rights.

demoReport.title: Synthetic demo JSON preview
demoReport.description: Demo only. Fixed illustrative values, not live Similarweb metrics or dataset results. No website-result events; Actor Start and applicable usage may apply.

demoCsv.title: Synthetic demo CSV preview
demoCsv.description: Demo only. Every observation is labeled synthetic; never used as customer traffic evidence.

demoMarkdown.title: Synthetic demo report preview
demoMarkdown.description: Demo only. Illustrates the reporting format and real-import setup steps. It does not establish source access, uptime, revenue or margin.

demoAgencyReport.title: Synthetic agency evidence preview
demoAgencyReport.description: Demo only: selected US preset's review signals and scope-quality checks. Every row is synthetic; zero dataset results and website-result events.

demoAlertsCsv.title: Synthetic alert CSV preview
demoAlertsCsv.description: Demo only. Labeled developer-authored change examples, not real traffic findings. Actor Start and platform usage may apply.

demoQualityCsv.title: Synthetic scope-audit CSV preview
demoQualityCsv.description: Demo only. Preview country-scope and comparison coverage checks without creating dataset results.
